name: Energy Ointment (Moderate)

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Cheliax, Infernal Inheritance

text:
Activate 10 minutes (manipulate)

---
This thick grease can be applied to up to 5 willing creatures to protect them from dangerous energies. This oil is attuned to one of four energy types (acid, cold, electricity, or fire), chosen when created. When applied, it grants resistance 10 to the attuned energy type and reduces the DC for the flat check to end persistent damage of the attuned energy type by 3.

The duration is 1 hour.

Effect: Energy Ointment (Moderate)
